title: Ultimate Judgment
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji made his choice, the core of the Heavenly Realm began to collapse, countless timelines scattering like shattered mirrors through the air—the Timeline War had officially begun.

text.content: Just as the Five Factions believed victory was within reach, Chen Ji threw his head back in laughter, the sound shaking the nine heavens. There was no fear in that laughter, only millennia of suppressed madness and determination—"A Five-Faction game? Perfect. I'm overturning the board!" Before the words even faded, the torn pages of the Tianji Record in his sleeve blazed with blinding golden light, piercing through layers of prohibitions and shooting toward the heavens, tearing a ferocious rift in the void. Within the rift, countless threads of destiny writhed wildly, as if some ancient existence was awakening from slumber.

dialogue.content: "Foolish chess piece." The voice did not come from within the rift, but sounded simultaneously from all directions, carrying an ancient and unchanging coldness. "Do you think overturning the board will free you from a piece's fate? You are merely accelerating your own destruction."

text.content: The ground beneath Chen Ji's feet began to crack, an indescribable pressure descending from above, as if the entire will of Heaven was converging in this moment to crush him into dust. He could feel his Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically; with each breath, tens of thousands of strands of destiny were being siphoned away by that invisible force. His knees bent slightly, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, but his spine remained as straight as a spear.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a mocking smile appearing on his blood-stained face. "I've been waiting for this day for a very long time." He raised his right hand, palm facing upward, as the torn pages of the Tianji Record trembled violently within. "Did you think I overturned the board to escape? Wrong—I want to shatter this table, along with every invisible hand beneath it!"

text.content: The rift suddenly expanded, and a massive eye slowly emerged from the depths of the void. That eye had no pupils, only endless white, within which countless images swirled—fragments of countless timelines, the final fates of puppets manipulated by the Eye of Heavenly Dao across millennia. And now, countless images focused simultaneously on Chen Ji alone, as if ten thousand judgments were descending at once.

dialogue.content: "Ultimate Judgment?" The voice from that massive eye carried a hint of amusement. "No, Chen Ji, this is merely giving you a chance to choose. Three paths lie before you—Destruction, Surrender, or Eternal Void. If you choose Destruction, the Five Factions will perish with you; if you choose Surrender, I will grant you unimaginable power; if you choose Void, you will vanish from existence itself, not even qualifying for reincarnation."

text.content: Chen Ji felt that power capable of destroying stars, yet the mockery at the corner of his mouth grew only more intense. He surveyed his surroundings, taking in the faces of the Five Factions' representatives—some terrified, some greedy, some desperate. Three paths, each a dead end—Destruction meant mutual annihilation, Surrender meant becoming a puppet, Void meant total oblivion. This was the choice the Eye of Heavenly Dao offered: seemingly giving choices, yet offering none at all.

dialogue.content: "What? Scared?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried a hint of mockery. "I have controlled seventy-two generations of Prophesiers, each of whom tried to resist, yet all ultimately had to accept their fated arrangement. You are merely the eighty-third ant who thought you could change everything. Choose now, time is running out—every moment you delay, your Heavenly Fate Value drains further, until you lose even the qualification to choose."

text.content: At this moment, a weak yet steadfast voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind—it was Chen Ling, the sister he had been searching for across countless chapters. Her voice was like a candle in the wind,随时可能熄灭, yet carrying undeniable resolve: "Brother, I sense it... there is a fourth path. Let me fuse with you, and I can show you the possibility of that path." Before the words finished, a soft light emerged from the Tianji Record over Chen Ji's heart, creating a strange resonance with the Heavenly Fate power within him.

Chen Ji felt a surge of both foreign and familiar power flood into his body—that was the call of bloodline, the bond between him and the Destiny Key, severed for years, reconnecting. He saw it—there, beyond those three dead ends, a faint and ethereal path materialized. That path lay not within the threads of destiny, not within the currents of time—it led toward... breaking the rules themselves.

dialogue.content: "The fourth path?" Chen Ji murmured softly, his eyes blazing with brilliance. He understood now—the reason the Eye of Heavenly Dao offered only three choices was because it fundamentally could not see the existence of a fourth path—because the fourth path was meant to break the rules set by the Eye of Heavenly Dao itself. He drew a deep breath, his voice suddenly turning cold and resolute. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao, you've miscalculated one thing—I was never your chess piece. I am the one who plays the game!"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sensed the existence of the fourth path, but the cost of this path remained unclear. The Eye of Heavenly Dao was urging him to choose, and the Five Factions' representatives held their breath in anticipation. Chen Ji had to decide immediately—whether to risk stepping onto that unknown road, or seek another way.

choices.text: Choose to fuse with Chen Ling and take the fourth path

choices.visible_reward: Perceive the existence of the fourth path
choices.risk_hint: An unknown path, an unknown cost

text.content: Chen Ling's light flowed into Chen Ji's body without hesitation, two consciousnesses intertwining in that instant. Countless fragmented images flashed before Chen Ji's eyes—Chen Ling's suffering through countless timelines, her use of every ounce of strength to preserve the last thread of clarity, only to point out that path to her brother at this crucial moment. Tears slipped silently down Chen Ji's face.

dialogue.content: "Sister..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, but in the next instant, that trembling transformed into iron-like resolve. He spread his arms wide, embracing that unknown fate. "Let's go!"

choices.text: Refuse the fusion and seek another way to break the deadlock
choices.description: The cost of the fourth path is too great; Chen Ji decides not to accept Chen Ling's fusion for now. He intends to use the power of the Tianji Record to deduce a more stable path.
choices.visible_cost: Time passes, Heavenly Fate Value continues to deplete
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not give him much time

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, saying to Chen Ling in his heart: "It's not the time yet, sister." Chen Ling's light dimmed slightly, but without complaint, she quietly retreated into the depths of the Tianji Record. She believed in her brother, as she always had.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao, you're impatient?" Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, that signature mocking smile appearing on his face. "Don't forget, I am the incomparably calculating Chen Ji. Do you really think I would have no backup plan?"

text.content: The massive eye of the Eye of Heavenly Dao narrowed slightly; for the first time, that ancient and unchanging existence showed a trace of... interest. "Interesting." Its voice echoed through the void. "Against absolute power, you can still laugh. Over countless years, you are the first to make me feel 'surprised.' However—" the voice turned icy cold, "surprise does not equal miracle. The more intensely you struggle, the deeper your pain when you vanish."

dialogue.content: "Then let me show you what a miracle looks like." Chen Ji forcefully activated the torn pages of the Tianji Record; the fragmented pages spun madly in his palm, countless golden runes dancing out like butterflies, weaving into an extremely complex diagram in the void. At the center of that diagram was a blank node—the entrance to the fourth path. "You think destiny is fixed? Wrong! Destiny... is meant to be rewritten!"

text.content: At this moment, a voice came from the depths of the Tianji Record—old, urgent, and familiar: Mo Xiansheng. "Chen Ji, do not act rashly! The cost of the fourth path far exceeds your imagination—once you take it, you will no longer be 'Chen Ji,' but become an existence beyond the Heavenly Dao itself... or, be erased from existence entirely!" The guardian of the remnant soul's voice was rarely tinged with anxiety. "Are you truly prepared? After making this choice, there will be no road back!"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng?" For the first time, a trace of fluctuation appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice. "You haven't dissipated yet? It seems from that battle back then, you preserved far more than I thought." The giant eye turned to Chen Ji. "You actually have the remnant soul of this old thing within you? No wonder you had the nerve to overturn the board. However, Chen Ji, are you truly willing to sacrifice everything you cherish for that虚无缥缈 fourth path?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. Sacrifice everything? Images flashed through his mind—Su Qingyao's cold yet deeply affectionate eyes, Ye Qing's vulnerability beneath her alluring mask, Han Lie's persistence beneath his ferocious exterior, Ling Yuan's hidden treacherous heart, and Chen Ling, the sister willing to be imprisoned for years for his sake... these people, these bonds—did he真的要全部抛弃吗?

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao was approaching, and Chen Ji had to make a decision within limited time. Mo Xiansheng's warning made him realize the cost of the fourth path, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's probing made the situation even worse. He had to choose—go all in, or find another way?

choices.text: Firmly take the fourth path, even if it means destruction
choices.description: Since this path was chosen, there is no reason to turn back. Chen Ji decided to risk everything, gambling his own existence for the possibility of breaking the rules of the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_reward: Possibility of breaking the rules of the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath; the Heavenly Fate Value within him rushed out like a breached flood. He felt his existence being slowly stripped away by the fourth path, pain like ten thousand arrows piercing his heart, yet he clenched his teeth and moved forward step by step. "Eye of Heavenly Dao... you've lost!"

dialogue.content: "Not because you are stronger than me, but because... I am willing to pay any price to break this game! Including myself!" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the void, carrying an unstoppable momentum. His figure began to fade transparent, countless rays of light bursting from within him.

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng." Chen Ji said in a deep voice. "Tell me the truth about the fourth path. I need to know all the possibilities before I can make the right choice." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then finally sighed and said: "Since your resolve is set, I shall tell you everything I know..."

dialogue.content: "The fourth path, in essence, transforms oneself into the Heavenly Dao itself—you will no longer be a player, nor a piece, but an existence that sets the rules. But the cost is... you will lose all human emotions and memories, becoming an absolute existence without selfish desires or bias."

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a low rumble; that ancient existence finally displayed true fury. "Enough!" Its voice exploded like thunder. "Chen Ji, did you think giving you choices was respecting you? No, it was merely entertainment in my boredom! Since you insist on seeking death—I shall grant your wish!" In an instant, devastating light burst from that massive eye, countless fetters of destiny surging toward Chen Ji like a tide.

dialogue.content: "Hahahaha!" Faced with that power sufficient to destroy an entire realm, Chen Ji laughed only more wildly. He spread his arms wide, welcoming those overwhelming fetters of destiny, his voice like an ancient war song. "Finally showing your true colors? Eye of Heavenly Dao, you are afraid! Afraid that I might truly walk the fourth path! Afraid that this ancient and unchanging game will truly be overturned by atrash disciple!"

text.content: Just as the fetters of destiny were about to touch Chen Ji, a familiar figure rushed out from the rift—it was Chen Ling! Her body was nearly transparent, clearly having broken through her constraints at great cost to come. She spread her arms, standing before Chen Ji, her voice carrying undeniable resolve: "Brother, this time, let me protect you!"

dialogue.content: "Ling..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; he saw in his sister's clear eyes no fear, no regret, only endless tenderness and determination. "I've waited for this day for so, so long." Chen Ling turned back, showing Chen Ji a brilliant smile. "It's so good to see you again. Now, let me do the last thing for you—clarify the fourth path!"

text.content: Chen Ling's body suddenly burst with dazzling light; that light resonated with the torn pages of the Tianji Record within Chen Ji, the two forces intertwining to weave an unprecedented path in the void. Chen Ji saw it—the end of that path was neither destruction nor void, but... the possibility of breaking all rules themselves! He finally understood the true essence of the fourth path: not to make Chen Ji become the Heavenly Dao, but to make the Heavenly Dao... unable to control anyone ever again.

"I see it now." Chen Ji's voice was low and firm. "The fourth path is not about me becoming a new Heavenly Dao, but about making it so that in this world... there is no more Heavenly Dao!" He reached out and grasped Chen Ling's hand, already dissipating—that touch was like holding a wisp of smoke. "Sister, I'm sorry... big brother came too late." Chen Ling shook her head, and with her last strength, wrote two characters in his palm: "Worth it."

The Eye of Heavenly Dao felt that power beyond the rules and finally displayed genuine fear. "Impossible! Impossible!" Its voice lost that ancient coldness for the first time, becoming sharp and manic. "The rules of destiny were set when heaven and earth first began—how could they be broken! You madman! You will destroy all of this! Including yourself!"

dialogue.content: "Mad?" Chen Ji threw his head back in wild laughter, his blood-stained face appearing infinitely ferocious in the light. "Eye of Heavenly Dao, you are wrong! I am not trying to destroy all of this—I am giving everyone the right to choose their own destiny!" He raised the Tianji Record high; the torn pages, infused with the power of the fourth path, began to reshape page by page. "This is the true Tianji Record—not prophesying destiny, but... rewriting it!"

text.content: At this moment, the core of the Heavenly Realm began to violently shudder, countless cracks spreading from all directions. Chen Ji stood at the center of the storm, behind him was his sister's final smile before dissipation, before him was the Eye of Heavenly Dao's fear-twisted massive eye, and beneath his feet was that path to the unknown fourth road.
